contests.title: Johnson County — Measure LY: Sheriff’s office and jail bonds

provenance.quote:
Public Measure LY: County Jail Bond (60% required)
Shall the County of Johnson, State of Iowa, issue its general obligation bonds in an amount not exceeding the amount of $94,500,000 for the purpose of acquiring land and constructing, equipping and furnishing a new sheriff’s office and jail facility?

contests.title: Hills — Measure LZ: Municipal building bonds

provenance.quote:
Public Measure LZ: City of Hills Bond (60% required)
Shall the City of Hills, in Johnson County, State of Iowa, enter into a loan agreement and issue general obligation bonds in an amount not exceeding $5,100,000 for the purpose of paying the cost, to that extent, of constructing furnishing and equipping a municipal building, including fire protection and city hall functionalities?

contests.title: Lone Tree Community School District — Measure MA: School improvement bonds

provenance.quote:
Public Measure MA: Lone Tree Community School District Bond (60% required)
Shall the Board of Directors of the Lone Tree Community School District in the Counties of Johnson and Louisa, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $6,900,000 to provide funds to remodel, repair, and improve the school building for energy efficiency, including HVAC, mechanical, electrical, and site improvements?

contests.title: Mid-Prairie Community School District — Measure VF: School improvement bonds

provenance.quote:
Public Measure VF: Mid-Prairie Community School District Bond (60% required)
Shall the Board of Directors of the Mid-Prairie Community School District in the Counties of Washington, Iowa, and Johnson, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $19,000,000 to provide funds to build, furnish, and equip an addition to the high school, including a new events entrance, auditorium, and fine arts classrooms, with related remodeling and improvements and related site improvements; and to renovate, improve, furnish and equip several existing special education and general education classrooms?

contests.title: Cedar Rapids — Measure D: Fire and emergency response bonds

provenance.quote:
Public Measure D



Shall the City of Cedar Rapids, State of Iowa, issue its General Obligation Bonds or Capital Loan
Notes in an amount not exceeding the amount of $60,000,000, in one or more series, for the
purpose of paying costs of designing, constructing, reconstructing, enlarging, improving,
equipping and furnishing fire stations and emergency response facilities, with related site
 improvements, consistent with the Cedar Rapids Fire Department Facility Plan, including but not
limited to a new training facility, relocating Stations 2 and 8, remodeling Stations 4 and 9,
rebuilding Stations 5 and 6, and the acquisition of real estate therefor, and acquiring new fire
trucks and related emergency response equipment?

contests.title: Ely — Measure E: Library expansion bonds

provenance.quote:
Public Measure E



Shall the City of Ely, in Linn County, State of Iowa, enter into a loan agreement and issue general
obligation bonds in an amount not exceeding $2,250,000 for the purpose of paying the cost, to
that extent, of constructing, furnishing and equipping an expanded municipal library?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $94.5 million in general-obligation bonds to acquire land and construct, equip and furnish a new sheriff’s office and jail. Approval requires 60% of the vote.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the sheriff’s office and jail bonds.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a loan agreement and up to $5.1 million in general-obligation bonds to construct, furnish and equip a municipal building with fire protection and city hall functions. Approval requires 60% of the vote.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the loan agreement and municipal building bonds.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $6.9 million in general-obligation bonds to remodel, repair and improve the school for energy efficiency, including heating and cooling, mechanical and electrical systems and site improvements. Approval requires 60% of the vote.

Authorizes up to $19 million in general-obligation bonds for a high school addition with an events entrance, auditorium and fine arts classrooms, related renovations and sites, and improvements to special education and general classrooms. Approval requires 60% of the vote.

Authorizes up to $60 million in general-obligation bonds or capital loan notes, in one or more series, for fire stations and emergency response facilities under the fire department facility plan. Projects include a new training facility, station relocations, renovations and rebuilding, related sites and land, new fire trucks and emergency response equipment.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the fire and emergency response financing.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a loan agreement and up to $2.25 million in general-obligation bonds to construct, furnish and equip an expanded municipal library.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the loan agreement and library expansion bonds.
